comment: Palutena's low detail (every VS battle draws it): triangles per object of the owner's approved Blender model after scripts/p6/look_reduce.py; 278 is the plan's cap. drop_parts_up_to: the shoes' stiletto heel blocks (separate six-triangle pieces, about a pixel in battle) go; relax_uv: the shoes' UV islands would block every collapse; class_min: the leg tubes keep four sides (rows 16-18, 21-23); keep_outline: the face keeps its front outline.
